Files read at that commit, with SHA-256 of the fetched bytes: QA_BEFORE_RELEASES.md 6a0e5254d79491e1b4e0dc360efcbe38689391145c1a0f21cb16fb413b7e428b; docs/SSD_STREAMING.md 923c1d9ba422bb110ae05d440e8a208883d64e4c708391967bcbbadc5a10be3d; ds4_metal.m 3075842282f423358bbfbf926282763fefbfd7dcbc86eb45a29c0ab84d35d38d; ds4.c eb0e98e650c04e99c22d7386286a935dd741f15095a3783e22c788c9a02d8f2b; ds4_bench.c f8cc29d57c1e37748273274611b85cad8fd71d1896e0f7c00a109f20ade57ad0. QA line numbers refer to that commit. ds4 used two M5 Max machines ('The reference ran on the other M5'); which machine produced each row is not always stated.
